_readme: Messages in chats listed in `internalChatIds` are saved to the internal archive server (`npm run archive:serve`) immediately, stay readable for `deleteDelaySeconds`, and are then deleted from Telegram for all participants. Ids use the same format as in hiddenChats.json: a user id for a person (e.g. "123456789"), a chat id with the leading minus for a group (e.g. "-1001234567890"). `archiveApiUrl` is the base URL of the archive server. Rebuild the app after editing.
